cases.name: testReadTableWith
cases.src:

      WITH TABLE KEY item_id = <ls_item>-item_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testLoopAtAssigning
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    LOOP AT mo_instance->get_all_items( )
      ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lo_item>).
      INSERT VALUE #( item_id       = <lo_item>->ms_data-item_id
                      item_category = if_any_interface=>cos_any_item_category-value )
        INTO TABLE lth_item.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    LOOP AT mo_instance->get_all_items( )
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lo_item>).
      INSERT VALUE #( item_id       = <lo_item>->ms_data-item_id
                      item_category = if_any_interface=>cos_any_item_category-value )
             INTO TABLE lth_item.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testCallAndCreateUnchanged

    CALL FUNCTION 'DATE_TO_PERIOD_CONVERT'
      EXPORTING
        i_date  = iv_date
      IMPORTING
        e_buper = ev_period.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_any_object
      EXPORTING
        i_date  = iv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CALL FUNCTION 'DATE_TO_PERIOD_CONVERT'
      EXPORTING
        i_date  = iv_date
      IMPORTING
        e_buper = ev_period.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_any_object
      EXPORTING
        i_date  = iv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testReceiveResultsSkipped
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    RECEIVE RESULTS FROM FUNCTION 'ANY_FUNCTION' KEEPING TASK
      IMPORTING  et_any                = lt_any
                 et_other              = lt_other
      EXCEPTIONS communication_failure = 1 MESSAGE lv_message
                 system_failure        = 2 MESSAGE lv_message
                 OTHERS                = 3.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testSubmitWithSelection
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
SUBMIT other_prog WITH SELECTION-TABLE rspar WITH par1 IN it_any
   WITH par2 EQ iv_other
WITH selcrit2 BETWEEN 'H' AND 'K'
  WITH FREE SELECTIONS texpr
                   AND RETURN.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
SUBMIT other_prog WITH SELECTION-TABLE rspar WITH par1 IN it_any
                  WITH par2 EQ iv_other
                  WITH selcrit2 BETWEEN 'H' AND 'K'
                  WITH FREE SELECTIONS texpr
       AND RETURN.
  ENDMETHOD.
